name: known-limitations-calibration-v1
labelers: Project-authored provisional calibration labels; not independent human adjudication
sampling_note: Twelve synthetic snapshots reuse known rule surfaces and semantic blind spots. This is a workflow calibration set, not held-out data, real user feedback, or a representative repository sample.
